liner.body_md:
## What listeners single out

- **When I Paint My Masterpiece** (2 reviews, 1 other source): A friend shouted out this title as a request just before it, and the band actually played it; Played faster than the reviewer had ever heard it [1][16][23]
- **Shakedown Street** (3 reviews): Second-set Shakedown flowing into Saint of Circumstance was hot; listener was up front; Opening the second set with it told the listener the party was on, with no letup afterward [20][21][23]
- **Morning Dew** (2 reviews): Jerry's jamming was so compelling that the listener stopped dancing just to watch; The Dew ends raucously, with Jerry sounding excited to play [21][25]
- **Walkin' Blues** (1 review): Seems its first 1987 appearance; Brent mostly hammers a single repeated note, making the arrangement fairly plain [19]
- **Row Jimmy** (1 review): Listener passed out during this song after nitrous, feeling Jerry sang directly to them [17]
- **Ship Of Fools** (1 review): Quite slow, yet Jerry made it work, adding emotion and different notes to his vocals [23]
- **The Other One** (1 review): Although not listed, The Other One emerges within Space on this recording [25]

## The recordings

- **gd1987-06-13.akg.thompson.motb.83747.sbeok.flac16** (recommended): source not stated; 20 songs; 156 min [1]. Said about its sound: Set 1 has many taper pauses at track starts or ends, with little or no music lost [1]
- **gd1987-06-13.sbd.walker-scotton.miller.83752.sbeok.flac16**: soundboard; 19 songs; 158 min; rated 3.75/5 by 8 [6]
- **gd1987-06-13.senn421-nak300.alexander.tetzeli.77268.sbeok.flac24**: source not stated; 19 songs; 158 min; rated 4/5 by 1 [7]. Said about its sound: Right channel is missing during pre-Cassidy crowd noise and Cassidy's first 35 seconds; left channel was pasted in as mono [7]
- **gd87-06-13.sbd.clugston.11895.sbefail.shnf**: soundboard; 19 songs; 150 min; rated 4.3/5 by 10 [10]. Said about its sound: The tape joins Mississippi Half-Step already in progress [19]
- **gd87-06-13.sbd.paino.10309.sbeok.shnf**: matrix (soundboard mixed with audience mics); 19 songs; 150 min; rated 4.4/5 by 5 [11]. Said about its sound: Sound quality is good but not great; it strains at times during Drums and Space [25]

## Around the show

- Listener stood about twenty feet from stage, dead center, and says friends all rated this show exceptional [14]
- Listener collapsed at intermission and was taken backstage by a security guard; mentions mysterious water bottles circulating that June [15]
- Listener says a big crowd of fans from San Diego attended [20]
- Listener brought a dog named Arrow and says they never missed a Ventura show [21]
- Crowd was a joyful, sun-drenched swirl of spontaneous expression; listener attended this show and the next one [22]
- Uploader's first Ventura show; the 1986 Ventura shows were cancelled and they missed the message, so they went unaware [2]

## Tapers and lineage

- **gd1987-06-13.akg.thompson.motb.83747.sbeok.flac16**: taped by Danny Thomson; transferred by A. Egert and J. Waddell; source: AKG C460b pre's with Ck61uls capsules > Uher CR240 > MAC (AKY Recording Supply Custom Wound BASF 100% CrO2 90 min) [1]. Also: Clugston soundboard supplies the end of Eyes and two minutes of Drums [1]
- **gd1987-06-13.sbd.walker-scotton.miller.83752.sbeok.flac16**: transferred by Charlie Miller; source: SBD -> Cassette Master (TDK MA-XG90/Sony D5) [6]. Also: Schoeps to PCM to DAT to CD patch supplies the first 26 seconds of Mississippi Half-Step [6]
- **gd1987-06-13.senn421-nak300.alexander.tetzeli.77268.sbeok.flac24**: taped by Tim Alexander; transferred by Bill Tetzeli; source: 2 Senn. 421s + 2 Nakamichi 300 shotguns > Yamaha Mixer > Sony D5 (Dolby B) [7]. Also: A tape flip occurs just before the Eyes jam ends into Drums; a small gap marks it [7]
- **gd87-06-13.sbd.clugston.11895.sbefail.shnf**: source: Master Soundboard Cassette > PCM > DAT> CDREAC'ed, SHN'ed and Seeded to Etree by Scott Clugston [10]
- **gd87-06-13.sbd.paino.10309.sbeok.shnf**: source: Matrix SBD>CASS>DAT>CD [11]

## Art and photos

- Poster by Ron Delany Grateful Dead: [1987-06-12 Ventura County Fairgrounds, Ventura, CA, USA - Jerry Garcia](https://jerrygarcia.com/show/1987-06-12-ventura-county-fairgrounds-ventura-ca-usa/) [27]
